observed_anchor.remaining_countercase: A rollback or clone that carries both the selected lineage state and its freshness anchor together can remain mutually consistent; an observation outside the VPS rollback domain is required to discriminate that world.

grf_candidate.generated_reality: A policy-pinned remote witness head outside the VPS snapshot domain can distinguish a stale local lineage checkpoint when boot requires exact witness sequence/hash and lineage sequence/head equality to an independently authenticated live cache-bypassed remote observation.
grf_candidate.causal_mechanism: The remote witness sequence and content hash advance outside the local rollback domain. A stale local checkpoint therefore falls behind the current remote head and must fail closed rather than boot.
grf_candidate.strongest_counter_reality: A stale cached or replayed remote witness paired with the same stale local checkpoint satisfies equality-only checks. Provider-side rollback, compromised mutation credentials, or a reader falsely asserting a fresh authenticated read can also defeat the candidate.
hidden_assumptions: The remote reader is independently trusted and cannot be controlled by Frank/model/GWT/Needle authority.
The remote source read is genuinely current and cache/replay resistant.
Remote witness mutation has provider-side anti-rollback semantics and protected credentials.
Local and remote checkpoint advancement can recover safely across crashes.
grf_candidate.falsifier: Show a permitted boot where the current trusted remote witness is ahead of, differs from, or is unavailable to the local lineage binding; or show crash recovery that cannot reconcile a partial local/remote witness advance without unsafe rollback or false acceptance.
